title: Negative numbers and the number line

learn.title: Numbers below zero
learn.body: Some quantities go below zero: a freezing temperature, a debt, a floor under the ground. We write these as negative numbers, with a minus sign in front, like $-5$. Positive numbers, negative numbers and zero together are called integers (along with all the whole numbers in between).

learn.title: The number line
learn.body: Picture a straight line with zero in the middle. Positive numbers sit to the right, negative numbers to the left. The further right a number is, the greater it is. So $-2$ is greater than $-7$, because $-2$ is further right.

learn.title: Opposites and absolute value
learn.body: Two numbers the same distance from zero on opposite sides are opposites: $5$ and $-5$. The distance from zero is the absolute value, written $|x|$. So $|-5|=5$ and $|5|=5$. A distance is never negative.

learn.title: Order $-3$, $2$, $-8$, $0$
learn.body: Put the numbers from least to greatest by their place on the number line.
steps: Find the negatives first. $-8$ is furthest left, then $-3$.
Zero comes next, then the positive number $2$.

learn.body: With negatives, a bigger digit means a smaller number. $-9$ is less than $-1$ because it is further left of zero.

questions.explanation: On the number line $-1$ is furthest right, so it is the greatest. $-10$ is the least.
Absolute value is the distance from zero. $-12$ is 12 steps from zero, so $|-12|=12$.
Opposites are the same distance from zero on the other side. The opposite of $-8$ is $8$.

questions.prompt: The temperature moves from $-5$ degrees to $-2$ degrees. What happened?
questions.explanation: $-2$ is to the right of $-5$ on the number line, so it is greater. The temperature rose by 3 degrees.

questions.prompt: Match each expression with its value.
questions.explanation: Absolute value drops the sign and keeps the distance from zero.

questions.prompt: Put these in order from least to greatest.
questions.explanation: Read the number line from left to right: the negative numbers come first, with $-6$ furthest left.
